# BAD-089 — Move the collab delivery rule into src/collab.js instead of writing it twice

## Brief
BAD-080 lands one rule — 'a take's delivery makes no read' — in two clients that cannot share code from my deliverables. collabTakeInFlight() and collabIdleBeat() are now near-identical in web/collabweb-sync.js and renderer/app.js, and the set of modes that ARE a delivery (upload-url, commit) is stated in collab/room.ts, implied in both clients and re-derived by regex in test/collabdelivery.test.js. src/collab.js is already the UMD module both processes load for exactly this reason ('one file is what keeps those two answers from drifting'), so a DELIVERY_MODES export plus a pure takeInFlight({pushInFlight, debounce, queued}) predicate would make it one definition with one unit test, instead of two copies pinned by a source-text assertion.

Evidence: web/collabweb-sync.js and renderer/app.js each declare collabPushInFlight + collabTakeInFlight + collabIdleBeat with the same three terms; test/collabdelivery.test.js's 'both clients hold the booth tick on the same three terms' exists only because there is no shared definition to test once. src/collab.js already exports claimFresh, claimRecording, CLAIM_LEASE_MS and RECORDING_FRESH_MS to both. src/collab.js was outside BAD-080's deliverables.
